name: Arva
mood: pastoral editorial magazine spread on a cream field
summary: A warm agricultural editorial style with bone paper canvas, deep forest green structural bands, vivid lime marquee accents, Reckless serif headlines, Inter body and UI text, oversized pill controls, full-bleed field photography, and quilted pastel card rows.

typography.displayFallback: Cormorant Garamond, GT Sectra, Source Serif Pro
typography.displayLightFallback: Cormorant Garamond Light, Source Serif ExtraLight

layout.model: full-bleed stacked bands with centered 1200px inner content, lime marquee, forest header, full-photo hero, bone sections, forest interstitials, and pastel quilt card grids

elevation.depth: surface color shifts, forest bands, pastel cards, and photography

dos: Use Bone as the base canvas for light sections.
Use 100px pill radius for every button variant.
Pair Reckless headings with Inter body and UI text.
Keep Vivid Lime scarce and mostly reserved for the marquee.
Rotate pastel surfaces across card rows in an intentional sequence.
Use Forest Ink for header, footer, and full-width section bands.
donts: Do not use pure white as the page background.
Do not use small utility radii on buttons or cards.
Do not add saturated colors beyond Forest Ink and Vivid Lime.
Do not use Reckless below 24px or for body copy.
Do not add box shadows to cards.
Do not mix multiple pastel colors inside one card.
Do not center long body paragraphs.
